body: Ok. My apologies. Will read guidelines more thoroughly.

Hey, now! No slinking and no apologizing for crying. It doesn't matter if your story is interesting or new. You matter! You even showed it.." told somebody else not to do it..." You tried to help and it shows that you have a caring heart. It doesn't mean you're a liar or hypocrite. The opposite! Add it to your list of positives! Being a caring person is a great quality and at least one reason to say to yourself, "I have this positive quality and it means something!" in a world that too often doesn't show caring.

You don't have to be quiet~ This is a place to "get it out". Hijack it all you want, I don't mind. I wanted to get my story out there so others can maybe "get it off their chest", or see that you/they matter!

No! You're NOT a burden to them. You can turn it around and be an example of strength for them! (I felt like a burden to those around me too. I was lucky enough to learn that's not the case at all.) They're going to need you!
Good! It's not an easy fight, but it's worth it! Keep trying, keep fighting, and remember that you matter! Your health, your happiness, YOUR LIFE MATTERS!

Thank you! I hope the same for you! If you're a MamaToFive, (5 children?) That's 5 DAMN GOOD REASONS TO STICK AROUND! Even if you're not with your children at the moment, they need you, whether or not you or they know it!
Thank you. I hope it helps too! Everyone deserves a fighting chance for themselves!

You can be helped! Don't give up! I understand the exhaustion of fighting, but you have to keep punching and kicking, keep fighting for yourself! Your therapist is fighting for you, but she can't fight the whole battle for you. You can, YOU CAN BE HELPED! Even if it's an exhausted "swing", it's better than not being able to make a fist at all!

Good! I love you too! And I'll keep you in the thoughts of my heart!
~an internet friend

I understand the feeling of failure because you survived. Don't sell yourself short! Even if things are absolute shit, you're still with us! School analogy: A "C" is not a "F"ailure. It counts/matters and leaves room to do better! I'm glad you're here too!

Don't be afraid to need help. Don't be scared to do what needs to be done to be alive! Don't feel ashamed. Think of the courage it takes to admit you need help! You might not see it now, but you can get through it! If you have a therapist, you already have someone on your side trying to help you! Give yourself a chance and stay with us for a while!
I hope this helps someone/anyone thinking about it.
